text:
alyssa: Auditor Sam wants an evidence timeline that links an RBAC change (clusterrolebinding add) with a vuln alert and a KMS access event. They want mapping to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO 27001 A.9.2.1.
devin: Do we have a concrete window? I can pull kube-audit, cloudtrail, and job logs.
sam_auditor: Window: 2024-01-15 00:00:00 UTC to 2024-01-18 23:59:59 UTC. Provide a CSV timeline with: event_ts, principal, event_type, resource, evidence_file, sha256, related_vuln_id (if any). Redact user emails.
leo: For the vuln side, which scanner? Snyk triggered an alert on 2024-01-16 referencing CVE-2023-####. We should include the Snyk alert export (json) and the triage notes.
devin: KMS event note: cloudtrail shows a FailedDecrypt event at 2024-01-16T08:12:03Z against alias/rdw-prod-cmk. It was a service principal `svc-image-builder`. Need to correlate with job run.
alyssa: Good catch. Sam wants proof whether that failed decrypt correlates to a config change or a role added that could have granted new access. Also need to show whether DEKs involved contain customer data.
leo: I can pull the Snyk export: `snyk test --json > snyk-20240116.json`. Triage note format: plain text with who confirmed and link to PR.
devin: Splunk query (kube-audit and job logs):

``
index=kube_audit OR index=jobs_logs earliest="01/15/2024:00:00:00" latest="01/18/2024:23:59:59" (verb=bind OR verb=create OR eventType=KMSFailedDecrypt) | table _time, user, verb, objectRef_kind, objectRef_name, src_ip, msg
``

devin: CloudTrail KMS filter: `eventName=Decrypt OR errorCode=KMS.InvalidCiphertextException` with that timeframe.
sam_auditor: Include key metadata (`aws kms describe-key`) and alias mappings. Also need an explanation if `svc-image-builder` is scoped to system-only DEKs.
alyssa: Who owns `svc-image-builder`? Leo?
leo: Yep that's in infra/team-image; it unwraps DEKs to build container layers but DEKs are supposed to be system-only. I'll confirm in runbook.
devin: Packaging plan: produce s3://redwood-audit-handovers/1810000001/ with: timeline.csv, snyk-20240116.json, cloudtrail-kms-slice.gz, kube-audit-slice.gz, key-metadata.json, rbacsnap-<commit>.yaml, triage-notes.md, chain_of_custody.txt, sha256sums.txt.
alyssa: Add a control-mapping.md that shows each file -> SOC2 control and ISO control mapping. Use control IDs Sam asked.
oncall-bot: Evidence ticket created: <https://tracker.redwood/EVID-2024-211|EVID-2024-211> (assigned to devin)
sam_auditor: Integrity: we require either PGP-signed manifest or manifest + sha256sums plus presigned tarball with 7d expiry. Also annotate any redacted fields and provide a reproducible query.
leo: I'll add a small note in triage-notes.md: `DEKs are system-only, contain no customer PII; build artifacts reference image layers only`. Will link to infra runbook `docs/internal/image-builds.md`.
devin: For RBAC snapshot: `git show <merge-commit>:manifests/rbac.yaml` and `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o yaml --namespace=cluster` at the merge commit. I'll include commit sha and PR link.
alyssa: Also include retention statements for logs: Splunk index TTL and S3 lifecycle rules. Sam will want to see retention policy proof.
sam_auditor: Also request: a short risk statement if the three events are related and our mitigation. One paragraph plus recommended next steps.
alyssa: I'll draft the risk statement. Example: "Failed decrypt by svc-image-builder concurrent with rolebinding add increases risk of unauthorized key material access; evidence shows no DEK with customer data was used; mitigate by rotating affected DEKs and restricting svc-image-builder scope."
devin: ETA: I'll stage artifacts and post presigned links in the ticket by EOD UTC tomorrow. Will include sha256sums and PGP signature of manifest.asc.
sam_auditor: Please mark any manual redactions with `REDACTED` and include original query to verify sampling.
leo: starting exports now. Ping if you need me to pull PR timelines.
alyssa: thanks team. I'll own the control-mapping doc and risk statement.
devin: ack, kicking off queries.
sam_auditor: Thanks all. We'll review once links are up. :thumbsup:
